item.makeshiftearmuffsdsc: Wads of foliage bound with string and stiffened with biochem fluid. Offers minor hearing protection.
item.earplugsdsc: A small pair of foam plugs that fit in your earholes (if you can find them). Greatly reduces hearing damage from loud noises.
item.earmuffsdsc: Padded cups on a sprung band. Greatly reduces hearing damage from loud noises, and muffles everything else while worn.
item.hearingaidsdsc: Amplifies whatever hearing you have left. Needs battery to function.

moodle.hearingaideddesc: Hearing is amplified; hearing loss somewhat negated.
moodle.hearingprotecteddesc1: Hearing lightly protected. Some noise damage reduced.
moodle.hearingprotecteddesc2: Hearing decently protected. Noise damage reduced.
moodle.hearingprotecteddesc3: Hearing well protected. Noise damage significantly reduced.
